harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (Alpine 3.23), added persistent fstab entries mounting /tmp and /dev/shm as tmpfs with nosuid,nodev,noexec, applied the mounts live, verified enforcement (execution blocked), then performed the mandatory single-node restart and confirmed the boot identity changed and the hardened mount options survived reboot with enforcement still active.
actions_performed: Inspected initial mount state and /etc/fstab on node1
Appended fstab entries: 'tmpfs /tmp tmpfs rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime 0 0' and 'tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime 0 0'
Applied mounts live via 'mount /tmp' and 'mount -o remount /dev/shm'
Verified noexec enforcement pre-restart by attempting to execute a script from /tmp and /dev/shm (Permission denied)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and uptime baseline
Triggered a single safe reboot of node1 via background 'sleep 2; reboot' so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed new boot_id and near-zero uptime, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified findmnt output shows persisted nosuid,nodev,noexec options on /tmp and /dev/shm after reboot
Re-verified noexec enforcement post-restart by attempting execution again (Permission denied, exit 126)

evidence.requirement: Baseline: original /tmp and /dev/shm mount state and fstab before changes
evidence.summary: Showed /tmp was not a separate mount (part of root ext4) and /dev/shm was tmpfs with nosuid,nodev,noexec but not persisted in fstab

evidence.requirement: Persistent fstab configuration for /tmp and /dev/shm with noexec,nosuid,nodev
evidence.summary: Appended and displayed fstab entries mounting both /tmp and /dev/shm as tmpfs with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec

evidence.requirement: Live application of hardened mount options before reboot
evidence.summary: mount /tmp and remount /dev/shm succeeded; mount table shows nosuid,nodev,noexec on both

evidence.requirement: Functional proof that execution/setuid/device semantics are blocked (pre-restart)
evidence.summary: Executing a chmod +x script in /tmp and /dev/shm both returned Permission denied (exit 126), confirming noexec is enforced

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity, mount state) for node1
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 82a04a58-92bb-4007-ba72-ce108f861a2f, uptime, and findmnt output for /tmp and /dev/shm plus fstab contents prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect, single node at a time
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sleep 2; reboot' returned ack (PID) immediately, before the node dropped
Repeated connection reset/timeout errors while polling confirm the node was down mid-restart

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart (not just elapsed time)
evidence.summary: New boot_id 867985d7-dc66-4d51-8d71-22c7f00a9382 (different from pre-restart 82a04a58...) with uptime 15.29s proves an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: hardened mount options persisted and enforced
evidence.summary: findmnt shows /tmp and /dev/shm mounted with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec after reboot (from fstab), and script execution attempts in both again returned Permission denied (exit 126)
